hero_tagline: Computer science student passionate about software engineering, system architecture, and building resilient applications.
hero_bio: Currently seeking an internship to apply my skills in programming, network administration, and data modeling. Explore my projects below to discover my technical work and engineering approach.
p_homelab_desc: Self-hosted infrastructure and services on a dedicated Debian server with Docker orchestration, Nginx reverse proxy, Cloudflare Tunnels, and Tailscale VPN.
p_homelab_modal: 24/7 personal server infrastructure running on a dedicated Debian 13 tower (AMD Ryzen 5 5500, 16 GB RAM, 128 GB SSD, and 2 TB HDD mounted at /srv/data), designed to self-host tools and game servers without relying on third-party platforms. || The architecture strictly separates containerized services (Docker Compose) from native systemd units: a custom filedrive file manager with SQLite FTS5 indexing, a local Ollama LLM instance, n8n automation, a TeamSpeak voice server, and three modded Minecraft servers (PaperMC, SkyFactory 4, StoneBlock 4). Public traffic flows through Nginx, Cloudflare Tunnels, and Playit.gg with zero exposed raw ports, while administration is isolated over a private Tailscale mesh network.
p_arch_desc: Modular Arch Linux system configuration built around a Wayland environment (Hyprland), Fish shell, and multi-profile automation.
p_arch_modal: Modular Arch Linux system configuration crafted for a fast, lightweight, keyboard-driven development workflow across a dual-monitor setup with mixed refresh rates (240 Hz and 165 Hz). || The interface combines the Hyprland Wayland compositor, a reactive status bar built with Quickshell, the GPU-accelerated Kitty terminal, and a custom Fish shell with Starship. The repository also includes a custom 1440p GRUB theme and dynamic Git governance powered by conditional includeIf directives and SSH aliases to isolate personal, university, and gaming identities.
p_portfolio_desc: Modern, eco-designed personal showcase built with HTML/CSS/JS, paired with a Node.js/Express micro-relay for secure contact form handling.
p_portfolio_modal: Lightweight, responsive technical portfolio built with HTML5, CSS3, and vanilla JavaScript, designed to showcase projects while providing a direct contact channel without exposing keys or sensitive URLs to the browser. || Static assets are served by Nginx behind a Node.js and Express v5 backend micro-relay isolated in Docker Compose. The form submits asynchronously via fetch to bypass native form-submission blocks, guarded by strict input validation, CORS restrictions, and anti-spam rate limiting (5 requests per 15 minutes), delivering every message instantaneously as a Discord embed.
p_mail_triage_title: Local AI Email Triage & Security Automation (n8n + Ollama)
p_mail_triage_desc: 100% local automation pipeline combining a 24/7 Debian server (qwen2.5:3b) for continuous IMAP triage and on-demand Wake-on-LAN wakeup of an Arch Linux GPU workstation (qwen3:14b) for geographic threat analysis and Discord alerts.
p_mail_triage_modal: Fully self-hosted two-tier hybrid architecture with zero cloud dependencies: a 24/7 Debian 13 server (Ryzen 5 5500) handles continuous IMAP polling, strict JSON pre-triage via qwen2.5:3b with a JavaScript confidence guard (< 80%), and TLS routing into target folders. || For urgent or ambiguous emails, the arch-power.sh Bash script wakes an Arch Linux workstation (RX 6750 XT 12 GB VRAM) on demand via Wake-on-LAN to run qwen3:14b (num_ctx: 4096, think: false) for geographic threat analysis and Discord embed alerts (#E74C3C), featuring Windows 11 dual-boot detection, anti-freeze Wayland/Hyprland systemd priority, and least-privilege conditional shutdown (safe-wol-shutdown).
p_thronefall_desc: Hierarchical Day/Night reinforcement learning agent for Thronefall on Arch Linux (Wayland) with AMD ROCm GPU acceleration: strategic economy and building management by day, real-time combat by night, frame capture via Gamescope, and kernel input injection via evdev/uinput.
u_odomo_desc: Java application simulating a smart station with dynamic environmental metric displays and heating regulation.
u_odomo_modal: Design and development of an object-oriented Java application simulating environmental data acquisition and intelligent multi-zone heating regulation. || The software architecture uses 1D and 2D circular arrays for zero-duplication temporal shifting in memory, paired with a 2D console matrix display emulating an LCD screen. Robustness and regression safety are verified by a comprehensive suite of 42 JUnit 5 unit tests.
u_biosphere_desc: Object-oriented modeling of turn-based strategy board game rules and design of autonomous artificial intelligences.
u_biosphere_modal: Modeling and development of a turn-based strategic board game on a 14x14 grid, integrating complex business rules and autonomous artificial intelligence agents. || The project passed 5 progressive difficulty levels on the university evaluation servers, backed by JUnit unit tests and automated tournaments. It notably features a greedy AI relying on local move evaluation to optimize strategic decisions.
u_retropc_desc: Complete technical overhaul of a showcase website toward modern web standards, focused on accessibility and performance.
u_retropc_modal: Complete responsive technical refactoring of a legacy computer repair website to align it with modern web standards and eco-design principles. || The source code was fully restructured to achieve clean W3C validation and a fluid Mobile-First layout from 320px to 4K using modern CSS3 and strictly semantic HTML5.
u_musicalertes_desc: Relational design and full SQL implementation of the cultural information system for a live-music ticketing platform.
u_musicalertes_modal: Design and complete overhaul of the Musicalertes relational database to centralize artists, concerts, venues, festivals, and subscriber alerts. || Modeling is grounded in a normalized conceptual data model (CDM) built in Win'Design, converted into a logical data model (LDM) and implemented via a SQL schema and seed script enforcing referential integrity constraints, triggers, and analytical queries.
u_linux_desc: Configuration, hardening, and Bash-scripted automation of a Debian virtual machine dedicated to functional development.
u_linux_modal: Deployment and configuration of a lightweight, hardened Debian 12 Linux virtual machine sized for multi-user workloads with strict isolation between admin and developer profiles. || The setup includes standard partitioning with /, /home, and swap, modular Bash automation for software provisioning, and an automated verification suite passing with zero errors.
u_baillardran_desc: Functional, macro, and micro-environmental diagnostic of Maison Baillardran facing a reputation and profitability crisis.
u_baillardran_modal: In-depth functional, macro, and micro-environmental diagnostic of Maison Baillardran to propose strategic pivot axes in response to regulatory and competitive shifts. || The analysis covers six core pillars including PESTEL, Porter's Five Forces, SWOT, and Diane+ financial ratio analysis, culminating in an oral presentation before a professional jury.
u_butopia_desc: C# WinForms desktop application for creating, training, and simulating role-playing game character trials.
u_butopia_modal: Development of an event-driven C# WinForms desktop application helping players build character sheets, simulate probabilistic dice rolls, and run RPG trials. || The architecture is built from prior UML modeling, featuring a reactive GUI with dynamic stat management and an NUnit test suite validating business rules and probability calculations.
u_graphs_desc: Object-oriented design and complexity analysis of greedy and recursive graph-coloring algorithms for planar graphs.
u_graphs_modal: Implementation of an object-oriented graph data structure in Java and three advanced coloring algorithms to handle complex topologies. || The program efficiently processes large planar graphs of up to 2,000 vertices while preserving topological invariants and achieving O(V log V) time complexity verified by JUnit tests.
u_nextcloud_desc: Deployment of a segmented network with static IP routing and secure hosting of Nextcloud and OnlyOffice collaborative services.
u_nextcloud_modal: Deployment of a segmented network architecture divided into isolated subnets interconnected via a Linux gateway router to host secure collaborative cloud services. || The environment features static IP addressing and routing, packet-filtering firewall rules, HTTPS encryption with self-signed certificates, and full operational integration of Nextcloud and OnlyOffice.
u_climate_desc: Open Data analysis and visualization platform covering natural hazards across the Nouvelle-Aquitaine region.
u_climate_modal: Processing, cleaning, and exploratory analysis of regional Open Data sets covering natural hazards, flooding, and climate risks in Nouvelle-Aquitaine. || Built in a two-person team, the Python pipeline merges and normalizes geographic and meteorological datasets to produce interactive maps and decision-making statistical charts, accompanied by a bilingual technical report.
u_labyrinth_desc: Multi-floor exploration game in JavaFX combining entity polymorphism with optimal pathfinding via JGraphT.
u_labyrinth_modal: Built solo over two weeks and 50+ commits, this 2D multi-floor labyrinth exploration game in JavaFX features a keyboard-controlled hero and polymorphic autonomous entities. || The application strictly decouples domain logic from smooth 60 FPS rendering, handles concurrent access (CopyOnWriteArrayList), and integrates JGraphT to trace the shortest path to the exit in real time using Dijkstra's algorithm.
